howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: A seamless 4-step interview preparation lifecycle: pick a track, connect with an interviewer or peer, code with AI hints, and get structured feedback.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Choose from specialized tracks tailored for Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, System Design, or Algorithms. Configure difficulty from Junior to Staff Engineer level.
howItWorks.taskFrontendJunior: Responsive Form with Zod Validation & Custom React Hooks
howItWorks.taskFrontendMiddle: Virtualized Infinite List with 10k Items & Windowing
howItWorks.taskFrontendSenior: LRU Cache with TTL, Memoization & React 19 Hooks
howItWorks.taskBackendJunior: REST API CRUD with JWT Authentication & Unit Tests
howItWorks.taskBackendMiddle: Worker Pool with Go Channels & PostgreSQL Transactions
howItWorks.taskBackendSenior: Idempotent Rate Limiter on Go & Distributed Redis
howItWorks.taskBackendLead: Distributed Message Queue with Exactly-Once Semantics
howItWorks.taskSysDesignMiddle: Social Feed Architecture with Fan-out & Caching
howItWorks.taskSysDesignSenior: Real-time Chat & Video for 10M DAU with WebSockets
howItWorks.taskSysDesignLead: Global Distributed Billing Engine with Raft Consensus
howItWorks.taskAlgoJunior: Two Pointers & Valid Anagram in O(n) Time
howItWorks.taskAlgoMiddle: Binary Tree Level Traversal & BFS Shortest Path
howItWorks.taskAlgoSenior: Dynamic Programming: Coin Change & Knapsack O(nW)
howItWorks.taskAlgoLead: Max Flow & Minimum Spanning Tree in O(E log V)
howItWorks.step2Title: Live video & audio interview with real engineers
howItWorks.step2Desc: Connect with peer developers or technical interviewers for a realistic round. Discuss architecture, explain your logic out loud, and collaborate with real-time video and crystal-clear audio.
howItWorks.step2Check1: Ultra-low latency video and crystal-clear audio
howItWorks.step2Check2: Participant showcase with filters by stack and seniority
howItWorks.step2Check3: Private password-protected rooms or instant mutual matchmaking
howItWorks.dialogueText: "Let's walk through how you would handle race conditions when two users book the same seat simultaneously."
howItWorks.candidateDialogueText: "I propose using a doubly linked list combined with a hash map to achieve O(1) for both get and put operations."
howItWorks.step3Title: Collaborative live coding & on-demand AI hints
howItWorks.step3Desc: Write code together in real-time with full syntax support and automated tests. Need a nudge? Use up to 3 AI hints per interview that provide guiding clues without spoiling answers.
howItWorks.step3Benefit1Desc: TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, Python, C++ with isolated fast runtime.
howItWorks.step3Benefit2Desc: Edge cases, memory benchmarking, and concurrency checks on keystroke.
howItWorks.step3Benefit3Desc: Up to 3 hints per round — gives directional clues without spoiling answers.
howItWorks.badgeLanguagesDesc: TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, Python, C++
howItWorks.badgeTestsDesc: Edge cases, concurrency tests, memory leaks
howItWorks.step3HintText: For O(1) access and eviction order, consider combining a Hash Map with a Doubly Linked List.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Get comprehensive evaluation on code cleanliness, time/space complexity, trade-off communication, and architectural decisions with actionable tips to level up.
howItWorks.recommendationText: Deep dive into cache invalidation race conditions under distributed Redis cluster partitions for L6 rounds.
howItWorks.skillAlgoComment: Optimal O(n) solution without memory leaks
howItWorks.skillCommComment: Clear and structured reasoning out loud
howItWorks.step4Benefit1Desc: Instant calibration against real leveling rubrics of BigTech and tier-1 companies.
howItWorks.step4Benefit2Desc: Granular evaluation of time and space complexity, code cleanliness, and edge cases.
howItWorks.step4Benefit3Desc: Actionable list of topics and architectural patterns to master before your next interview.
